sources.title: Python 3.12 typing
sources.supports: TypedDict is a runtime dict, not automatic validation; Union equivalence; NotRequired denotes a potentially absent key; Optional allows None.

sources.title: Python 3.12 map

sources.title: Use the graph API
sources.supports: Return updates rather than mutate state; explicit START/END connections; add_node; compile; invoke; conditional routing.

sources.title: Messages
sources.supports: System, human, AI and tool roles; AI tool_calls carry requests; ToolMessage.tool_call_id matches the request ID; examples may be hand-authored.

limitations: The movie-card demo, badge exercise, strict input validation and conditional paper sketch are original added practice, not video-assigned homework.
No LLM, tool dispatcher, external API or tracing request is required or performed. Message objects are explicitly hand-authored teaching examples.
The runnable badge graph is linear and includes zero sessions; the conditional alternative is a paper-only preview for L05.
Shared runtime imports langsmith and python-dotenv but the default none backend does not load .env. No agent accessed .env.
The shared CLI can deliberately enable remote tracing with other backends; L01 validation uses none only. --live is unnecessary and does not add a model call.
